wish: someone should make a tool that edits math equations visually
spec:
Builds an equation the way it looks on paper: fractions, roots, powers, subscripts, Greek letters and operators, with a caret you place by tapping.
Type or tap the palette (/ makes a fraction, ^ a power, _ an index), see it rendered live, copy it as LaTeX, or paste LaTeX back in to edit it visually.
It does not do matrices, integral limits layouts or solve anything; it keeps the last equation on this device only.
